meta.name: sdxl_img2img_v1
meta.description: SDXL img2img graph for layout conditioning (T-0106, docs/design/13-asset-pipeline.md §6.11) -- CheckpointLoaderSimple -> LoadImage(init) -> VAEEncode -> KSampler (denoise<1.0 preserves the init image's layout while textures regenerate) -> VAEDecode -> SaveImage. CLIPTextEncode positive/negative unchanged from sdxl_txt2img_v1. No EmptyLatentImage: the latent comes from the encoded init image, so output dimensions follow the init image, not recipe.width/height. Node IDs are stable across renders; bump `version` and add a new template file for graph-shape changes, never edit node IDs in place.
